name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the full CopilotKit quickstart project: created a Next.js app, installed `@copilotkit/react-core` and `@copilotkit/runtime`, wrote the `[[...slug]]/route.ts` runtime handler with `BuiltInAgent`, wrapped the layout in `CopilotKitProvider`, and added the `CopilotSidebar` to the page. TypeScript type-checking (`npx tsc --noEmit`) passed cleanly with exit code 0, confirming the code compiles. However, the production build (`npx next build`) was killed mid-process, so I never reached a running server or a working copilot endpoint. Two deviations from the docs were necessary: I had to use a placeholder `OPENAI_API_KEY` because no real key was exported in the sandbox environment, and I had to disable Turbopack in `next.config.ts` because the default build was being killed.
